# Fragments — Full AI Reference

https://www.usefragments.com

Generated — do not edit by hand. Source: `apps/docs/scripts/generate-llms-full.ts`.

## Overview

> Fragments keeps agents on your design system while they write. The loop is local: a card at session start, a check on every save, a repair before you look. The gate is Cloud: the same contract, required to merge. The open-source substrate is @usefragments/ui (component library on Base UI headless primitives) and @usefragments/core (types, schemas, rules engine); @usefragments/cli runs init, discover, check, and repair; Fragments Cloud binds a repository and serves the hosted MCP tools.

## Install

### Source

```bash
npx @usefragments/cli add button card checkbox alert
```

### Package

```bash
npm install @usefragments/ui
```

  Members: `Drawer.Body`, `Drawer.Close`, `Drawer.Content`, `Drawer.Description`, `Drawer.Footer`, `Drawer.Header`, `Drawer.SwipeArea`, `Drawer.Title`, `Drawer.Trigger` · Props: `children`, `defaultOpen`, `disablePointerDismissal`, `modal`, `onOpenChange`, `onOpenChangeComplete`, `open`, `snapPoints`, `swipeDirection=down|left|right|up`
- [Menu](https://www.usefragments.com/components/menu) — Drops a list of actions below a trigger, driveable entirely by keyboard.

  Members: `Popover.Body`, `Popover.Close`, `Popover.Content`, `Popover.Description`, `Popover.Footer`, `Popover.Title`, `Popover.Trigger` · Props: `children`, `defaultOpen`, `modal`, `onOpenChange`, `open`

### Utilities

- [ComponentDefaults](https://www.usefragments.com/components/componentdefaults) — Utility provider that sets the default control size for every control below it.
  Props: `children`, `controlSize=lg|md|sm`, `value`
- [Theme](https://www.usefragments.com/components/theme) — Utility provider that gives everything below it a light, dark, or system color mode.
  Members: `Theme.Button`, `Theme.Provider`, `Theme.Root`, `Theme.Toggle`, `Theme.useTheme` · Props: `attribute=class|data-theme`, `children`, `componentDefaults`, `defaultMode=dark|light|system`, `defaultTheme=dark|light|system`, `mode=dark|light|system`, `onModeChange`, `storageKey`
- [VisuallyHidden](https://www.usefragments.com/components/visuallyhidden) — Keeps text in the accessibility tree while taking it off the screen.
  Members: `VisuallyHidden.Root` · Props: `as=div|span`, `children`

## CLI (51 commands)

- `npx @usefragments/cli add` — Install source components from a registry (alias of `registry add`)
- `npx @usefragments/cli auth` — Inspect CLI authentication
- `npx @usefragments/cli auth status` — Verify the stored exact-binding OAuth session
- `npx @usefragments/cli bridges` — Manage confirmed package-to-local canonical bridges
- `npx @usefragments/cli bridges add` — Append validated canonical bridge entries to fragments.config.ts
- `npx @usefragments/cli build` — Build compiled fragments.json and .fragments/ directory
- `npx @usefragments/cli check` — Check source files for design-system drift
- `npx @usefragments/cli checkpoint` — Pin and manage dirty-worktree snapshots for scoped governance
- `npx @usefragments/cli checkpoint clear` — Delete one checkpoint or all checkpoints
- `npx @usefragments/cli checkpoint create` — Create a named checkpoint of the current worktree
- `npx @usefragments/cli checkpoint list` — List checkpoints and work changed since each snapshot
- `npx @usefragments/cli codemod` — Mechanical source migrations for consumers of the component kit
- `npx @usefragments/cli codemod ui-vocabulary` — Rewrite @usefragments/ui call sites to the ruled prop vocabulary (variant/tone/size/gap/status)
- `npx @usefragments/cli conform` — Conform source files to governance policy and prove a clean pass
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract` — Edit this repository's Fragments Cloud contract from the terminal
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract sources` — Token source files pinned by the Cloud contract
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract sources add` — Add token source paths (applies when the repository scan already sees them)
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract sources list` — Show the pinned token sources, canonical sources, and pending proposals
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract sources remove` — Remove token source paths that no longer exist (applies immediately for admins)
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract sources replace` — Point a token source at the path the file moved to
- `npx @usefragments/cli contract undo` — Restore the contract an applied edit replaced, while it is still the latest revision
- `npx @usefragments/cli discover` — Propose fragments.manifest.json from the design-system sources
- `npx @usefragments/cli doctor` — Prove the Fragments enforcement hook chain is armed
- `npx @usefragments/cli explain` — Explain a Fragments FUI code
- `npx @usefragments/cli hook` — Install or remove the Fragments contract hook for an AI agent
- `npx @usefragments/cli hook install` — Install the Fragments contract hook for an agent
- `npx @usefragments/cli hook uninstall` — Remove Fragments contract hook entries for an agent
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity` — Inspect and decide local component identity
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity consolidate` — Propose proven usage-site swaps through the conform preflight
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity dismiss` — Dismiss a wrapper decision and classify it as a shadow
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity migrate-report` — Compare canonical finding reports without updating a baseline
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity promote` — Promote a component through the canonical contract authoring path
- `npx @usefragments/cli identity sanction` — Sanction a review-tier wrapper as a local variant
- `npx @usefragments/cli init` — Install local Fragments guardrails, agent hooks, and CI
- `npx @usefragments/cli login` — Authorize the CLI for one exact Fragments repository binding
- `npx @usefragments/cli logout` — Revoke and remove the CLI session for one exact binding
- `npx @usefragments/cli mcp` — Run the local Fragments MCP server, or print hosted setup
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry` — Generate and inspect Fragments Registry artifacts
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry add` — Install source components from a registry (default: the public usefragments-ui)
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry artifact` — Generate a local installable source registry artifact
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry diff` — Compare installed registry source against a registry artifact
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry migrate` — Migrate an npm UI app to registry source install
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry status` — Inspect the local registry lockfile and installed source state
- `npx @usefragments/cli registry sync` — Refresh installed registry source using the existing lockfile selection
- `npx @usefragments/cli scan` — Zero-config fragments.json generation from source code
- `npx @usefragments/cli status` — Inspect generated Fragments guardrail configuration
- `npx @usefragments/cli tokens` — Design token discovery, listing, and generation
- `npx @usefragments/cli tokens generate` — Generate CSS, SCSS, Tailwind, or Figma output from a DTCG .tokens.json file
- `npx @usefragments/cli tokens list` — Discover and list design tokens from CSS/SCSS/DTCG files
- `npx @usefragments/cli validate` — Validate fragment files
- `npx @usefragments/cli view` — Generate a static HTML viewer for fragments.json

## Hosted MCP (6 tools)

- Endpoint: https://app.usefragments.com/api/mcp
- Interactive clients: OAuth
- Headless clients: OAuth (same as interactive clients)

- `design_system/conform` — Rewrite a snippet of UI code so it matches THIS project's design system. Swaps raw HTML elements and components from other libraries (Material UI, shadcn/ui, Chakra, or custom) to the project's own components and import paths, renames cross-library props and translates their values when the mapping is confirmed, and replaces hardcoded colors/spacing/radii with the project's design tokens. Call this whenever the user says 'fix this', 'make this match our design system', 'use our components here', right after pasting markup from elsewhere, or before committing UI you wrote. Input is the code itself — no repo access needed. Returns a conformed version plus a list of changes with rationale. Ambiguous prop changes and accessibility gaps (e.g. a button or image with no accessible name) come back as suggestions for you to apply — they are never auto-rewritten.
- `design_system/edit_contract` — Repair or propose changes to the repository's Cloud contract. Token-source removals, and replacements or additions the current repository discovery evidences, apply immediately for org admins and return an undoable receipt; canonical-source changes, member proposals, and unevidenced paths land as a pending revision an org admin approves on the Contract page. Requires the mcp:write scope and a paid workspace. Pass undoReceiptId to revert an applied edit while it is still the latest revision.
- `design_system/get_evaluation` — Read one finalized historical governance evaluation by its receipt ID. The server applies the credential's organization, project, binding, and repository scope to the receipt and every related receipt. Missing, unfinished, malformed, and unauthorized receipts all return not_found. Lineage, reasons, publication, and repair metadata are bounded; malformed stored evaluation details project as an error with a null result.
- `design_system/list_primitives` — List the design-system primitives Fragments Cloud has indexed for this project, with import paths and source file paths where available. May include auto-classified candidates that a human has not yet confirmed.
- `design_system/list_tokens` — List the design-system tokens Fragments Cloud has indexed for this project. Returns factual token names, values, categories, and source metadata.
- `design_system/prove_compliant` — Run a closed validate-fix-validate loop over generated UI code until Fragments can prove it has zero design-system findings, or return the remaining issues. Uses deterministic fixes first and may suspend on MCP Sampling; replay is hash-keyed, so only changed code revalidates, and an empty or identical sample ends the loop.

## Rules (25 rules)

Tiers: `contract` = armed by adopting a contract; `opt-in` otherwise.

Until a contract exists, the customer default produces zero findings.

### a11y

- `a11y/required-accessible-name` — [FUI3001](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI3001) — opt-in — Accessible name is required
- `a11y/standard` — [FUI3002](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI3002) — opt-in — Accessibility standard failed

### components

- `components/forbidden-prop-value` — [FUI6004](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI6004) — opt-in — Prop value is forbidden
- `components/prefer-library` — [FUI1004](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI1004) — contract — Library component should be preferred
- `components/preferred-component` — [FUI1002](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI1002) — opt-in — Preferred component should be used
- `components/shadow-component` — [FUI1007](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI1007) — contract — Component shadows a canonical primitive
- `components/unknown-prop` — [FUI6005](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI6005) — opt-in — Component prop is unknown

### composition

- `composition/cardinality` — [FUI5003](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI5003) — opt-in — Too many of a component in one region
- `composition/co-occurrence` — [FUI5004](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI5004) — opt-in — Required companion component is missing from the region

### imports

- `imports/preferred-path` — [FUI1003](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI1003) — opt-in — Import should use the preferred path

### props

- `props/invalid-value` — [FUI6002](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI6002) — opt-in — Prop value is invalid

### styles

- `styles/no-raw-color` — [FUI2005](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2005) — opt-in — Raw color should use a token
- `styles/no-raw-dimensions` — [FUI2004](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2004) — opt-in — Raw dimension should use a token
- `styles/no-raw-spacing` — [FUI2006](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2006) — opt-in — Raw spacing should use the scale
- `styles/no-raw-typography` — [FUI2016](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2016) — opt-in — Raw typography should use a token

### tailwind

- `tailwind/arbitrary-color` — [FUI2007](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2007) — opt-in — Tailwind arbitrary color should use a token
- `tailwind/arbitrary-spacing` — [FUI2008](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2008) — opt-in — Tailwind arbitrary spacing should use the scale
- `tailwind/forbidden-palette` — [FUI2009](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2009) — opt-in — Tailwind palette is forbidden
- `tailwind/off-scale-spacing-token` — [FUI2011](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2011) — opt-in — Tailwind spacing token is off scale
- `tailwind/raw-color-via-token` — [FUI2010](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2010) — opt-in — Tailwind color should use a resolved token
- `tailwind/unknown-class` — [FUI2012](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2012) — opt-in — Tailwind class is unknown

### theme

- `theme/no-theme-coupled-literal` — [FUI2014](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2014) — opt-in — Theme-coupled literal should use a semantic token

### tokens

- `tokens/css-vars-must-be-defined` — [FUI2015](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2015) — contract — CSS variable is not in the contract vocabulary
- `tokens/require-dual-fallback` — [FUI2003](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2003) — opt-in — Token fallback is required
- `tokens/upstream-drift` — [FUI2017](https://www.usefragments.com/errors/FUI2017) — contract — Local token differs from its declared upstream source
